topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't believe this is happening. They just assumed the worst, didn't even give you a second to explain. It's like everyone's ready to jump on the bandwagon, pointing fingers, and treating you like you're some kind of cheat. Did they even think to ask why your work looked different this time? Maybe you actually put in the effort, did the research, poured your heart into it. And now, you're left to clean up this mess all because someone couldn't be bothered to give you a fair shake. I’m there for you, no matter what. We'll sort this out, and they’re going to have to listen.
